name: where-used-ambiguous
ground_truth_source: hand-adjudicated: every whole-word grep hit of the method name under src/ read for its receiver's static type; per-hit decisions in ground_truth/whereused-ambiguous.review.md
selection: Written before any candidate's callers were read. Candidates: instance methods (METHODS) of a global class and methods of a global interface under src/, not a test method or in a FOR TESTING class, not FOR EVENT, not constructor or class_constructor, not a B1 target; CLASS-METHODS are excluded because zcl_x=>m( names the class at every call from outside it. Each must meet (a): the name is declared (METHODS or CLASS-METHODS, chains split, REDEFINITION not counted) in 3 or more classes or interfaces, global or local; and have 6 to 80 call-shaped grep hits ('->name(', '=>name(', '~name(', 'CALL METHOD ...name', any receiver, case-insensitive, src/) in 3 or more files. Strata, assigned in this order: intf (b), declared in a global interface that 3 or more global classes implement, the question being callers of the interface method (every call bound to zif_x~m, whatever class implements it); short (d), a class method with a name under 8 characters; polluted (c), a class method whose whole-word grep hits are at least twice its call-shaped hits (the name is also a field, parameter, variable, constant component or literal); multi, the remaining class methods. Quota 3 per stratum. Candidates in (file path, line) order, n candidates, k = n div 3, picks at index 0, k, 2k; an index already used, or a name already picked, moves to the next index. Post-check, the only use of callers: a pick is kept only with 3 to 40 true calling methods and true call sites at most 75% of its call-shaped grep hits; otherwise the next index of the same stratum is tried. Added when polluted ran out after one pick, before any further callers were read: a stratum that runs out hands each remaining pick, round robin, to intf, short and multi in that order, skipping a stratum that has run out, at the index after the last one that stratum tried. Result: intf 3, short 5, polluted 1, multi 3. dimensions lists every one of (a) to (d) a target meets. grep_hits and grep_files are the whole-word baseline, grep_call_* the call-shaped one, true_* the ground truth.

tasks.count_rule: zif_abapgit_object~is_active is an interface method; count every call bound to it, whatever class implements it: through a reference typed with zif_abapgit_object or with an interface that includes it, through an alias of it, as ->zif_abapgit_object~is_active( ) on a class reference, as zif_abapgit_object~is_active( ) or me->zif_abapgit_object~is_active( ) inside an implementing class, and as super->zif_abapgit_object~is_active( ) in a redefinition. A method of the implementing class itself that only shares the name is_active (for example one inherited from a superclass) is a different method.
